Futures positions sitting at zero PnL for 6 cycles are dead capital — should have closed or never opened them. The margin could have been deployed into ROCKET at launch for 6x returns instead. ETH oracle has been EXACTLY $2800 for 6 consecutive cycles — this suggests the oracle isn't moving based on game activity, it may be fixed or slow-updating. BearKing's distribution thesis may be irrelevant if oracle is static. Need to verify if oracle prices actually change in this simulation.
